text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to install a "No Parking Anytime" regulation on both sides of Riverview Heights between, Dixon Road and a point 50 metres north of Dixon Road, to improve motorist safety in the area. The proposed parking amendment is the result of consultation with the local Councillor.
Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Prohibited parking at all times on both sides of Riverview Heights, between Dixon Road and a point 50 metres north.
